title: ENTERPRISE SAAS AND SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENT

clauses.title: 1. UPTIME COMMITMENT AND AVAILABILITY
clauses.text: 1. UPTIME COMMITMENT AND AVAILABILITY. Provider warrants that the SaaS Platform shall achieve ninety-nine point nine percent (99.9%) system availability during each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance windows.

clauses.title: 2. SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE NOTIFICATION
clauses.text: 2. SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE NOTIFICATION. Provider shall provide at least seventy-two (72) hours advance electronic notice for all scheduled downtime, which shall occur only between 00:00 and 04:00 UTC on weekends.

clauses.title: 3. SERVICE LEVEL CREDITS
clauses.text: 3. SERVICE LEVEL CREDITS. If monthly uptime falls below ninety-nine percent (99.0%), Customer is entitled to a fifteen percent (15%) service credit applied against the subsequent monthly billing invoice.

clauses.title: 4. DATA PROTECTION AND SECURITY AUDITS
clauses.text: 4. DATA PROTECTION AND SECURITY AUDITS. Provider shall maintain SOC 2 Type II compliance and encrypt all Customer data in transit and at rest using AES-256 encryption.

clauses.title: 5. UNILATERAL CUSTOMER INDEMNIFICATION
clauses.text: 5. UNILATERAL CUSTOMER INDEMNIFICATION. Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Provider from all third-party claims, liabilities, and legal fees arising from Customer's transmitted content.

clauses.title: 6. AGGREGATE MONETARY LIABILITY CAP
clauses.text: 6. AGGREGATE MONETARY LIABILITY CAP. Provider's total aggregate liability under this agreement is strictly capped at the total subscription fees paid by Customer during the prior twelve (12) months.

clauses.title: 7. TERMINATION FOR CAUSE
clauses.text: 7. TERMINATION FOR CAUSE. Either party may terminate immediately upon written notice if the other party commits a material breach and fails to cure within thirty (30) days of written demand.
